payload.reason: The evidence provides multiple claims regarding the effectiveness of the NCEL approach, demonstrating its superior performance compared to baseline methods across various datasets and its efficiency in processing large-scale data.

claims.text: NCEL consistently outperforms various baselines with favorable generalization ability across five public benchmarks.
In both easy and hard datasets, NCEL outperforms all baseline methods, indicating its effectiveness in diverse scenarios.
The integration of GCN and attention mechanisms in NCEL enhances its performance and robustness against noisy data.
NCEL is efficient for large-scale data processing due to its unique approach of applying GCN on subgraphs.
